meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: Claude 会先读仓库状态再动手,把请求分成提交、改写历史、查历史、看状态四类。回答带具体证据:提交哈希、文件路径、行号与命令输出。
howto.when: 当任务需要做一次提交,或要调查 git 历史(谁改的、何时改的、哪个提交引入)时接管;普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这些改动按功能拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先看 diff 再分组暂存,逐个提交并报告哈希

say.text: 是谁在哪个提交里改了这个函数?给出证据
say.note: 用 log -S、blame 定位并附哈希与行号

say.text: 把本分支最近三个提交压缩成一个
say.note: 会先确认是否已推送再改写历史

howto.what_en: Claude reads the repo state first, then sorts the request into commit, history-rewrite, history-question, or status modes. Answers cite concrete evidence: commit hashes, file paths, line numbers, command output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation (who, when, which commit). Ordinary code edits do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Split these changes into a few atomic commits
say_en.note: Reads the diff, stages groups, commits each

say_en.text: Who changed this function, and in which commit? Show evidence
say_en.note: Uses log -S and blame with hashes and lines

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits on this branch into one
